context.description: A running tool is not a stall

evidence.trustReason: Given: the real task supervisor and sessionEvents relay consume a running tool-part update for T1.1, while silent T1.2 is a same-clock control. When: simulated time advances 10 seconds, five times the 2-second stream idle bound, and the control stalls. Then: no T1.1 task.stalled fact, cancellation, or new prompt appears; its turn stays in tool state. And: after a completed tool-part update the turn returns to watching, has no stall at 1.9 seconds, and records the exact stall at 2.1 seconds with cancellation and continuation. Focused current-code test passes.
